name: Saw It Straight: the carpenter's yard
used: Saw It Straight: the background. The sawhorses, the plank and the Saw Bird are drawn on top.
standin: A plank wall hung with tools and a sandy yard drawn in code.
prompt: {STYLE} {SCENE}The yard in front of an old wooden carpenter's workshop on a still, pale morning. Across the top of the picture, from about 12% to 40% of the height, the workshop's weathered board wall, with a few tools hanging on nails (a hammer, a carpenter's square, a coil of rope) and a small window. Below it the yard: packed earth and sand, scattered with a few curls of wood shavings and sawdust near the edges. Keep the middle of the yard plain and quiet from 42% to 92% of the height and from 20% to 80% of the width (no sawhorses, benches, planks or logs there), because the game puts two sawhorses and a long plank across the middle. A neat stack of logs may sit at the far left and a wheelbarrow at the far right, both kept small.

name: Saw It Straight: planks
used: Saw It Straight: the plank on the sawhorses. The game stretches it to each plank's length, draws the chalk line and the cut over it, and splits it along the cut when it is sawn through.
standin: A wood-coloured band with grain lines drawn in code.
prompt: {STYLE} {SHEET} A 1 x 3 grid: three long, plain, unmarked wooden planks, one per row, each lying flat and seen from above at a slight slant so its wide top face is visible and, under it, a thin strip of its near edge, the face about ten times as tall as that edge strip. Each plank fills its cell's whole width (cut square at both ends) and about 60% of its height, with long straight grain lines running along it. Top row pale pine; middle row honey-coloured oak; bottom row reddish cedar. No knots, no saw cuts, no pencil or chalk marks.

name: Saw It Straight: sawhorse
used: Saw It Straight: the two sawhorses the plank lies across (the same picture twice).
standin: A beam and four splayed legs drawn in code.
prompt: {STYLE} A single old wooden sawhorse seen from the front and a little above: a flat beam across the top, about 1.5 times as wide as the sawhorse is tall, and four splayed legs, nicked and paint-spattered, standing on the ground. Centred, filling about 80% of the frame's width. {ALPHA}

name: The Saw Bird sawing
used: Saw It Straight: the Saw Bird as it saws back and forth along the line, its teeth in the cut.
standin: The portrait (or its stand-in), standing with its blade over the plank and its legs dangling.
prompt: {STYLE} {VARIANT}The Saw Bird (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoai2k/mini/main/icecreamcone/game/assets/subjects/sawbird.png ) at work, facing left: its long blade held perfectly level, pointing left, with the toothed edge straight along the bottom, and its legs folded up tight under its handle-body so that nothing hangs below the line of the teeth: the teeth are the lowest part of the picture. Eye narrowed in concentration, a few curls of sawdust at the teeth. {ALPHA}

name: The Saw Bird snagged and proud
used: Saw It Straight: the Saw Bird caught on a knot (or after a crooked cut), and standing proud beside the plank after a straight one.
standin: The sawing pose shaken for a snag; the portrait hopping beside the plank for pride.
prompt: {STYLE} {VARIANT}The Saw Bird (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoai2k/mini/main/icecreamcone/game/assets/subjects/sawbird.png ) in two poses side by side on one sheet, each in its own half, facing left: left half, snagged, framed exactly like its sawing pose (blade level and pointing left, toothed edge along the bottom, legs folded tight under its handle-body so the teeth are the lowest part), but with the blade bowed and twanging (a few small ink wobble lines beside it) and its eye wide in alarm; right half, proud, standing upright on its two thin legs at the portrait's scale, blade raised high at an angle like a salute, chest out, a few curls of sawdust at its feet. {ALPHA}
